selection_boundary: Created after E15 completed and before any E15R held-out call.
rationale: E15 Qwen3-8B had three IPER adapter errors caused by empty output after two 4096-token completions. The official Qwen3 model card provides a hard non-thinking mode for efficiency. A thinking-mode recovery candidate passed request probes but its first full IPER development episode did not finish within 20 minutes, so it was rejected before formal freeze.

profiles.role: Prospective operational recovery of the E15 Qwen3-8B cell

reporting_boundary: E15R is a separate post-E15 recovery experiment and never replaces E15.
